title: StackStopParams
description: stack.stop's params: what semiont stop takes, but its help.

apiVersion.description: The version of the control API the request is written to.

target.description: Which knowledge base's stack. Absent: the one the command line chooses, standing where the control server was started.

runtime.description: The container runtime to ask, as --runtime names it. Absent: the one the stack's record names, else every installed one.

service.description: Just this one service, as --service names it.

group.description: Just this one group of services, as --group names it.

delete.description: For a codespace target: destroy the codespace, state and all, and forget its record. The command line's --delete. Refused without deleteConfirmed.

deleteConfirmed.description: That the person confirmed the deletion: delete is refused with control.confirmation-required without it.

dryRun.description: Whether to stop nothing, and report each runtime command a stop would run as a command progress line.
